title: Top-level OTEL chat payloads render twice in trace Pretty view
answers: trace detail shows duplicate User and Assistant cards
Pretty view repeats chat messages for OTEL span inputs and outputs
why does the span input chat show up twice in the trace viewer
duplicate chat messages in MLflow trace Pretty mode
body:
Symptom: In the trace detail Pretty view, a span whose input or output is a top-level OTEL-style chat array (`[{role, parts:[{type, content}]}]`) shows its User/Assistant cards twice.
Root cause: ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView.tsx:renderNonChatFields re-rendered the anonymous top-level field (key '') through the generic field renderer after ModelTraceExplorerChatSections / ModelTraceExplorerConversation had already rendered it as chat.
Fix pattern: getInputChatMessages and getOutputChatMessages now also return hasTopLevelChatPayload. When it is true, filterNonChatFields drops the field with key '' before rendering, while named non-chat fields still render.
Constraints: Applies only when the chat cards came from the top-level payload. Named fields such as `{messages: [...]}` keep their generic rendering and must not be filtered.
applies: Pretty render mode of the trace span detail panel (model-trace-explorer v2 right pane), for inputs and outputs separately.
says: Trace detail Pretty view displays duplicate User and Assistant chat message cards.
Conversation messages appear twice in the right pane when viewing trace spans.
Top-level chat inputs and outputs repeat inside the trace explorer span viewer.
Fix duplicate message bubbles showing up in the trace span detail view.
Span input cards should only render once in the trace Pretty display mode.
search: Top-level OpenTelemetry chat payloads in trace span inputs and outputs render duplicate cards in the trace detail Pretty view. In ModelTraceExplorerDefaultSpanView.tsx, renderNonChatFields re-rendered the anonymous top-level field with key '' after chat sections already displayed it. getInputChatMessages and getOutputChatMessages return hasTopLevelChatPayload to signal filterNonChatFields to drop the empty-key field before generic rendering. This filtering applies only to top-level payloads in the v2 right pane, while named fields like messages retain generic rendering.
